text: We don’t stop playing because we grow old, we grow old because we stop playing.
author: George Bernard Shaw

text: What video games have taught me is that if you are fighting enemies on your journey, you’re heading the right way.
author: Bill Murray

text: It’s not our abilities that define us, but our choices.
author: Albus Dumbledore

text: Knowledge is useless if it is not used.
author: Gixx, Guild Wars 2

text: Truth is like a sculpture; one perspective is never enough for true understanding.
author: Penumbra: Requiem

text: Software and cathedrals are much the same – first we build them, then we pray.
author: Sam Redwine

text: There are two ways of constructing a software design. One way is to make it so simple that there are obviously no deficiencies. And the other way is to make it so complicated that there are no obvious deficiencies.
author: C.A.R. Hoare

text: Anyone can make the simple complicated. Creativity is making the complicated simple.
author: Charles Mingus

text: Testing can only prove the presence of bugs, not their absence.
author: Edsger W. Dijkstra

text: Everyone knows that debugging is twice as hard as writing a program in the first place.
author: Brian Kernighan

text: The biggest difference between time and space is that you can’t reuse time.
author: Merrick Furst

text: Quality means doing it right when no one is looking.
author: Henry Ford

text: Any sufficiently advanced bug is indistinguishable from a feature.
author: Rich Kulawiec

text: All parts should go together without forcing. By all means, do not use a hammer.
author: IBM manual, 1925

text: If you have an apple and I have an apple and we exchange apples, we each still have one apple. But if we exchange ideas, each of us will have two ideas.
author: George Bernard Shaw

text: Find out what you like doing best and get someone to pay you for doing it.
author: Katharine Whitehorn

text: Computers are man’s attempt at designing a cat: it does whatever it wants, whenever it wants, and rarely ever at the right time.
author: Anonymous
